_comment: Builds the odds ratio from the cross-product ad/bc on Table 12; the answer is unitless.

stem.en: From Table 12, the four cells are 33 exposed cases, 55 exposed controls, 2 unexposed cases and 27 unexposed controls. Use the cross-product ad/bc to calculate the odds ratio. Give the answer as a number to 2 decimal places.

explanation.en: ad = 33 x 27 = 891 and bc = 55 x 2 = 110, so the odds ratio is 891 / 110 = 8.10. A ratio has no unit: it says the odds of smoking were 8.10 times as high among the men with lung cancer.

hints.en: Multiply the two diagonal cells first: exposed cases with unexposed controls, and exposed controls with unexposed cases.
